sniper_run.title: Sniper run stream
sniper_run.description: run-sniper's merged output: wall-clock stamp, process tag, then the line as the process wrote it (sim.stdout, or the terminal capture).  The optional [src] / [src:tid] after the tag is the producer's own marker: [SNIPER], [TRACE:1], [MimicOS], [SIFT:0].

proc.description: which process wrote the line: sniper, kernel (userspace MimicOS), appN, rankN

src.description: the producer's own marker, e.g. TRACE, MimicOS, SNIPER, SIFT

tid.description: thread or core id carried by the marker, e.g. the 1 in [TRACE:1]

sample.line: 2026-09-17T03:59:49.400000 [sniper] 0          [3783107]  [ 0]  [barrier_sync_server.: 296]  *ERROR* No threads running, no timeout. Application has deadlocked.
